id: title:jonmcwest:mask iso 8601 timestamps in pattern miner templates

review.posthog_relevance: Adds timestamp pattern recognition and placeholder support to the backend configuration and documentation, potentially enabling the masking of ISO-8601 timestamps alongside other PII-like patterns.
review.reason: The chunk adds a timestamp regex and placeholder to the configuration and documentation, and includes a test for pattern fingerprinting. While the actual backend implementation and presentation are not present, the configuration and documentation changes are substantive and bounded, supporting a tier 1 score.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the configuration and documentation changes, but the actual benefit depends on the missing backend implementation and presentation, which are not included in this chunk.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the pattern matching, fingerprinting, or the actual mining and presentation of the timestamp pattern. It only shows additions to the configuration, documentation, and tests. Without seeing the backend implementation, it is not possible to assess the tier or the actual benefit. The score is Unassessed.
